claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says Antarctica contains ancient Federation star bases, used for planetary control since the last Tiamat-related flood around 12,500 years ago.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says many bases are abandoned and some remain active.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu describes Antarctic Federation bases as multispecies underground cities linked to other deep bases by high-speed magnetic trains.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says nonhuman visitors use Antarctica as an entry point before traveling underground.
